name: agent-browser
description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
one_liner: A command-line tool that lets an AI assistant open a real web page, read what's on it, and click or type on it, one step at a time.
buyer: An automation agency owner who builds 'AI does web tasks for you' workflows for small-business clients that still run on forms and dashboards with no API.
business_use_cases: An automation agency uses it to build 'AI logs into your supplier portal and checks stock/prices nightly' services for small retailers.
A QA shop offers website-testing-as-a-service, using it instead of hand-written Playwright scripts, billed per site per month.
A no-code automation platform bundles it as the hidden browser engine behind a 'let AI do web busywork' feature for customers.

money_ideas.idea: Hosted browsing-agent API that automation builders pay to call per task
Custom automation builds for clients with no API, billed per integration

steal_this: This weekend, build a tiny service that logs into one client's supplier or competitor website nightly and emails them a price/stock change report, powered by this CLI.
